slides.h1: Write a first line people stop for.
slides.lead: Most people scroll past. Your first line decides if they don't.
"Nobody in my building knows each other" beats "I built an app."
"Rejected by Apple 7 times" is a hook. "Huge success" is noise.
If you need three ideas, that's three posts.
Short lines. Plain words. No buzzwords.
When a hook works, write the next one in the same shape.

slides.h2: The first line is the whole ad.
